_design_notes.purpose: Non-destructive exit defaults for Path B baseline. Corrections, not optimizations.
_design_notes.finding_1_breakeven_strangle: Old breakeven_after_r_multiple=0.05 moved stop to breakeven after a 0.05R move — trades reaching +2.73% median MFE closed at -0.09%. Fixed: breakeven only after 1.0R, so a winner must earn real cushion before its stop tightens.
_design_notes.finding_2_clock_dependence: 90% of >20% winners exited via MAX_SIM_WINDOW_EXIT — the sim clock, not a strategy exit. Fixed: trailing stops widened to let winners run on price action, and max_simulation_days set so the clock is a backstop, not the default.
_design_notes.finding_3_partial_profit: Old sell_pct=1 (short) dumped the entire position at 0.05R = instant tiny 'win'. medium sell_pct=0 took nothing. Fixed: take a real partial (33%) at a real target (1.5R) to bank some gain while leaving runner exposure.
_design_notes.status: FROZEN defaults for baseline. Do NOT tune until Path B entry edge is measured through these.
